data.narrative:
RMFG, a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company led by Kenneth Cassel, has raised $4.5M to date. The valuation universe spans 11 same-sector peers (1 public, 8 private identified), including comparable-stage or adjacent players such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis, the sole applicable triangulation method, anchors valuation to the $4.5M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding an implied value of $11M. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-filter datapoints—while the robotics and manufacturing sector contains 11 peers, same-stage and adjacent-stage subsets fell short of the three-company threshold needed for reliable median calculation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $13M, with a median point of $11M. This range reflects standard early-stage progression dynamics but carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the sparse comparable set at RMFG's stage. Investors should note that narrower peer data and the absence of recent financing rounds for true stage-peers limits confidence in the step-up multiplier itself. Validation through follow-on financing or expanded sector benchmarking would strengthen conviction on this estimate.
